scenes.subtitle: A new note: A on fret 5.
lines: In this lesson, you'll learn the note A on fret 5.
It's part of level 2 of 12, 'First notes'.

scenes.heading: A new note: A
lines: You've played up to fret 4 — now reach to fret 5 on string 1 for the note A.
Use finger 3 on fret 3, then stretch finger 4 (your pinky) to fret 5, or shift your hand up slightly.
It feels a little awkward at first, but your fingers will grow stronger and more flexible with practice.
You're learning to play real music, one note at a time.

scenes.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
lines: Each note lights up as you play it.
Follow the pattern on the tab and fretboard.
Play the A on fret 5, stretching finger 4.
The app is ready to listen — play your Twinkle, Twinkle now.
